name: Lighthouse Exterior
description: You stand before a weathered lighthouse perched on a rocky outcropping. The structure rises from the jagged rocks like a defiant sentinel. Storm-battered and salt-stained, it shows its age in every peeling layer of paint. The heavy metal door remains sealed tight. A small intercom unit is mounted beside the entrance.
visited_description: You are outside the lighthouse. The storm is getting closer, and the wind whips around the tower.

interactables.name: door
interactables.description: A heavy metal door, rusted by years of salt spray. It's firmly locked.

actions.examine: display_text:The door is made of thick metal and shows signs of corrosion from the sea air. It appears to be locked from the inside.
actions.open: display_text:You try the handle, but the door is locked tight.
actions.force: display_text:The door is too solid to force open.

interactables.name: intercom
interactables.description: A weathered intercom unit with a single red button, mounted beside the door.

actions.examine: display_text:An old intercom system. A small red button sits beneath a speaker grille. It looks like it's still functional.

interactables.name: window
interactables.description: A small window high on the side of the lighthouse, covered with a metal grate.

actions.examine: display_text:The window is too high to reach and protected by a rusted metal grate. You can't see inside.
actions.look: display_text:The window is too high and obscured to see through.
